messages.subject: TitanCNA v1.2.1 is released
messages.body_plain:
Dear users,
TitanCNA v1.2.1 has been pushed to Bioconductor SVN. This version patches a critical memory bug. Please do not use TitanCNA v1.2.0. See Installation <http://compbio.bccrc.ca/software/titan/titan-installation/> page for more details.

As well, an updated TITANRunner-0.1.1 can be downloaded from the Downloads <http://compbio.bccrc.ca/downloads/> page. This version of the TITANRunner python ruffus pipeline is compatible with TitanCNA v1.2.1.  TITANRunner-0.0.3 can still be downloaded for use with TitanCNA v1.0.0.

Summary of changes:

=================================================================================

TitanCNA version 1.2.1 changes (Committed revision 92909.)
=================================================================================
1) Critical bug fix for memory usage
- Affected public functions: runEMclonalCN
- bug in memory management in C implementation of logsumexp for forwards-backwards algorithm
2) Fixed bug for decoding TITAN state when symmetric = FALSE
- Affected public functions: loadAlleleCounts, runEMclonalCN, outputTitanResults
- loadDefaultParameters now returns list element “symmetric”. This is then propagated to being a list element in the output of the runEMclonalCN function. In turn, this output is required in the function outputTitanResults. outputTitanResults now requires “symmetric” element from convergeParams argument to determine whether the allelic ratio data was analyzed under symmetric mode.
3) Changed default parameters
- Affected functions: loadDefaultParameters
- genotypeParams$alphaKHyper initialized to 15,000 prior counts for all states
4) Updated Vignette with Subclone profile output
- Affected function: outputTitanResults
- Additional argument, “subcloneProfiles” to indicate whether to output subclone profiles. This only works for 1 or 2 clonal clusters in the solution
- New function: plotSubcloneProfiles
- Plots the copy number profile for the predicted subclones. Only works for 1 or 2 clonal clusters in the solution

Gavin

messages.subject: TitanRunner not waiting for jobs to finish
messages.subject_clean: TitanRunner not waiting for jobs to finish
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
I'm in the process of running the TITAN pipeline using titanrunner on our cluster which is using moab to manage job submissions.  When I run titanrunner, jobs are submitted to the cluster without incident.  It soon errors out (I've replaced the path and file name with [path_to_file]):

No way to run job: Input file '[path_to_file]_02_reads.wig' does not exist

To standard output you get this...

Task enters queue = helpers.pipeline.ReadCounter

Task enters queue = helpers.pipeline.NormalHetPositions

2293336.clusman0.localdomain

2293337.clusman0.localdomain

2293338.clusman0.localdomain

2293339.clusman0.localdomain

2293340.clusman0.localdomain

2293341.clusman0.localdomain

2293342.clusman0.localdomain

2293343.clusman0.localdomain

2293344.clusman0.localdomain

2293345.clusman0.localdomain

2293346.clusman0.localdomain

2293347.clusman0.localdomain

2293348.clusman0.localdomain

Completed Task = helpers.pipeline.ReadCounter

Task enters queue = helpers.pipeline.CorrectReads

The read count jobs are: 2293338, 2293339, 2293342, 2293343.  The problem is that readcounter has not finished yet but the runner tries to run the next step in the pipeline anyways.  Obviously this is still being generated since the job was only submitted seconds earlier.  I have never been exposed to ruffus before but from my reading on it, the runner relies on the @files(..) to make sure the previous step has finished.  For some reason (probably because our queue manager is different) this doesn't seem to be working probably.  Do you have any guidance on how I can modify the runner so it properly waits for the various steps to finish?  The next steps do seem to work once the required files have been generated and I use the -r option to restart the run, however, it seems to occur again at the next step in the pipeline.

messages.subject: Typo in Titan.R
messages.body_plain:
There appears to be a typo in the Titan.R file.

loadAlleleCounts(...) should be loadAlleleCountsFromFile(...)
messages.body_snippet:
There appears to be a typo in the Titan.R file.

loadAlleleCounts(...) should be loadAlleleCountsFromFile(...)

messages.subject: Re: Typo in Titan.R
messages.body_plain:
Hi Ryan,

TitanCNA v1.0.0 uses loadAlleleCountsFromFile(...) but in v1.2.0 or higher, this has been changed to loadAlleleCounts(...) because it can optionally load from a data.frame as well.

TitanRunner v0.1.1 or higher (which is compatible with TitanCNA R package v1.2.1+) reflects this change.

You should try to obtain the latest version of TitanCNA (v1.3.0) using the instructions found here:
http://compbio.bccrc.ca/software/titan/titan-installation/
See Step 3ii.

Thank you for your interest in TitanCNA.
Gavin
